Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Engineering Solutions specializes in providing comprehensive engineering and surveying services. Our operations include land surveying, civil engineering design, project management, and construction inspections. We focus primarily on residential and commercial projects, ensuring all work adheres to local regulations and industry standards. Our team implements rigorous quality control measures and employs subcontractors selectively, with documented safety protocols and performance reviews. We have a strong commitment to client satisfaction and strive for excellence in all our projects.
